# RefManageR

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ropensci/refmanager/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/refmanager/actions)
[![AppVeyor Build
Status](http://ci.appveyor.com/api/projects/status/github/ropensci/RefManageR?branch=master&svg=true)](http://ci.appveyor.com/project/ropensci/RefManageR)
[![Coverage
Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/ropensci/RefManageR/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://coveralls.io/github/ropensci/RefManageR?branch=master)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/RefManageR)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=RefManageR)
[![CRAN_Download_Badge](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/RefManageR)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=RefManageR)
[![](https://badges.ropensci.org/119_status.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/119)
[![](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.00338/status.svg)](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.00338)
`RefManageR` provides tools for importing and working with bibliographic
references. It greatly enhances the `bibentry` class by providing a
class `BibEntry` which stores `BibTeX` and `BibLaTeX` references,
supports `UTF-8` encoding, and can be easily searched by any field, by
date ranges, and by various formats for name lists (author by last
names, translator by full names, etc.). Entries can be updated,
combined, sorted, printed in a number of styles, and exported. `BibTeX`
and `BibLaTeX` `.bib` files can be read into `R` and converted to
`BibEntry` objects. Interfaces to `NCBI Entrez`, `CrossRef`, and
`Zotero` are provided for importing references and references can be
created from locally stored `PDF` files using `Poppler`. Includes
functions for citing and generating a bibliography with hyperlinks for
documents prepared with `RMarkdown` or `RHTML`.

Please see the [vignette](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1403.2036v1) for an
introduction and
[NEWS](https://github.com/ropensci/RefManageR/blob/master/inst/NEWS.md)
for the latest changes.

To install the latest version from `GitHub`:

    install.packages("remotes")
    remotes::install_github("ropensci/RefManageR")

# Package index

## All functions

- [`BibEntry()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/BibEntry.md)
  : Enhanced Bibliographic Entries
- [`BibOptions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/BibOptions.md)
  : Set options/hooks for RefManageR
- [`Cite()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md)
  [`PrintBibliography()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md)
  [`Citep()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md)
  [`AutoCite()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md)
  [`Citet()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md)
  [`TextCite()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md)
  [`NoCite()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/Cite.md) :
  Cite a BibEntry object in text and print all citations
- [`GetBibEntryWithDOI()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/GetBibEntryWithDOI.md)
  : Lookup a Bibtex entry using a Digital Object Identifier
- [`GetPubMedByID()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/GetPubMedByID.md)
  : Retrieve citation information from NCBI's Entrez for a set of PubMed
  IDs
- [`GetPubMedRelated()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/GetPubMedRelated.md)
  : Retrieve related articles from PubMed using PubMed ID's
- [`LookupPubMedID()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/LookupPubMedID.md)
  : Retrieve PubMed ID's for a BibEntry object
- [`ReadBib()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/ReadBib.md)
  : BibLaTeX/BibTeX .bib file parser
- [`ReadCrossRef()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/ReadCrossRef.md)
  : Search CrossRef for citations.
- [`ReadGS()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/ReadGS.md)
  : Import book and article references from a public Google Scholar
  profile by ID.
- [`ReadPDFs()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/ReadPDFs.md)
  : Create bibliographic information from PDF Metadata.
- [`ReadPubMed()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/ReadPubMed.md)
  : Search NCBI's E-Utilities for citation information
- [`ReadZotero()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/ReadZotero.md)
  : Get Bibliography Information From a Zotero Library.
- [`` `[`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/SearchBib.md)
  [`SearchBib()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/SearchBib.md)
  : Search BibEntry objects by field
- [`UpdateFieldName()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/UpdateFieldName.md)
  : Rename a field in a BibEntry object.
- [`WriteBib()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/WriteBib.md)
  : Create a BibTeX File from a BibEntry Object e Creates a Bibtex File
  from a BibEntry object for use with either BibTeX or BibLaTex.
- [`as.BibEntry()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/as.BibEntry.md)
  [`is.BibEntry()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/as.BibEntry.md)
  : Coerce to a BibEntry object
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/as.data.frame.BibEntry.md)
  : Coerce to a Data Frame
- [`c(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/c.BibEntry.md)
  : Combine BibEntry objects.
- [`` `$`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/cash-.BibEntry.md)
  : Extract fields from a BibEntry object
- [`` `$<-`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/cash-set-.BibEntry.md)
  : Replace values for a particular field in a BibEntry object
- [`head(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/head.BibEntry.md)
  [`tail(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/head.BibEntry.md)
  : Return the first or last part of a BibEntry object
- [`levels(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/levels.BibEntry.md)
  [`fields()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/levels.BibEntry.md)
  : Extract all fields present in a BibEntry object
- [`` `+`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/merge.BibEntry.md)
  [`merge(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/merge.BibEntry.md)
  : Merge two BibEntry objects while discarding duplicates
- [`` `names<-`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/names.BibEntry.md)
  [`names(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/names.BibEntry.md)
  : Names (keys) of a BibEntry object
- [`open(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/open.BibEntry.md)
  : Open BibEntry in PDF viewer or web browser.
- [`print(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/print.BibEntry.md)
  : Print BibLaTeX bibliography Entries
- [`sort(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/sort.BibEntry.md)
  : Sort a BibEntry Object
- [`` `[[`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/sub-sub-.BibEntry.md)
  : Extract entries from a BibEntry object by index
- [`` `[[<-`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/sub-subset-.BibEntry.md)
  : Assign a BibEntry entry to another BibEntry object
- [`` `[<-`( ``*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/subset-.BibEntry.md)
  : Update Different Fields of Multiple Entries of a BibEntry Object
- [`toBiblatex()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/toBiblatex.md)
  [`toBibtex(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/toBiblatex.md)
  : Convert BibEntry objects to BibTeX or BibLaTeX
- [`RelistBibEntry()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/unlist.BibEntry.md)
  [`unlist(`*`<BibEntry>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/RefManageR/reference/unlist.BibEntry.md)
  : Flatten and unflatten BibEntry objects
